title: cyclodium acrostichoides
intro: Cyclodium acrostichoides, commonly known as the Walking Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its unique ability to move its fronds, giving it a distinctive appearance. The health benefits of Cyclodium acrostichoides include its potential to aid in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedation, analgesia, and antispasmodic effects.
